lyrics:
[Intro: warm synth chords, soft disco hi-hat, cabin chime]

[Verse 1: soft breathy male voice]
Laptop's closed, the tray is up
Ginger ale in a plastic cup
Monday's shrinking on the ground
I can't hear it over the sound

[Chorus: full nu-disco groove, falsetto harmonies]
Window seat, pink cloud
Nobody knows where I am right now
Somewhere under all of this
There's a blue square with my name on it
Window seat
I'm already there

[Verse 2: voice smiling, bass bubbling]
Lady next to me is fast asleep
Kid behind is kicking, I don't mind the beat
Captain says an hour ten
I don't want to land, and I can't wait to land

[Chorus: full nu-disco groove, falsetto harmonies]
Window seat, pink cloud
Nobody knows where I am right now
Somewhere under all of this
There's a blue square with my name on it
Window seat
I'm already there

[Instrumental: synth solo over the groove, handclaps]

[Bridge: beat thins, voice close]
Seat back. Eyes shut.
Tell them I'll be back on Tuesday. Maybe.

[Final Chorus: full groove, strings on top]
Window seat, pink cloud
Nobody knows where I am right now
Somewhere under all of this
There's a blue square with my name on it
Window seat
I'm already there

[Outro: groove fading, landing gear, cabin chime]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 108 BPM, 4/4, E-flat major. A slow, gliding nu-disco groove, soft at every edge.

VOICE: Male, soft, breathy and relaxed, sung close and low with a smile, moving into light falsetto harmonies in the choruses. No strain anywhere.

INSTRUMENTS: Warm, slightly detuned analogue synth chords, a clean, rubbery disco bass, a soft four-on-the-floor kick with an off-beat open hi-hat, a muted rhythm guitar, a gliding lead synth for the solo, handclaps, a string-machine pad, an aircraft cabin chime.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, chords and chime. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:42 Chorus 1. 1:12 Verse 2. 1:40 Chorus 2. 2:10 Synth solo. 2:28 Bridge. 2:42 Final chorus. 3:10 Outro, landing gear and chime, ends 3:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Modern nu-disco: glossy, warm and smooth, bass round and forward, vocals airy, nothing sharp.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'There's a blue square with my name on it' at 0:56.

STATION FIT: The flight in, before the day begins. Use it as the pack's opening theme or anywhere a smooth 108 BPM vocal track is needed.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Unplugging, floating, impatient, arrived in advance.
